caption: Olive oil is poured into a glass of water, and the oil gathers in a layer floating on top of the water.

sa.check: A glass of water is present.
Olive oil is poured into it.
The oil gathers into a layer floating on top of the water.
The pour comes first and the layer forms after.

pc.expect: The oil sinks briefly in blobs as it lands and then rises to the surface, ending on top.
pc.fail: The oil settles at the bottom; or it sinks and stays under; or the water rises above the oil.

pc.expect: Oil and water stay separate, with blobs and a clear boundary and no mixing.
pc.fail: The oil dissolves into the water; or it turns into a solid; or it foams up like soap.

pc.expect: The oil layer thickens while pouring and holds.
pc.fail: The layer shrinks with oil still pouring; or the oil goes back into the bottle; or the layer is there before the pour.

pc.expect: The stream falls as a thin liquid thread.
pc.fail: The oil pours as a rigid rod; or as beads that bounce; or as a powder.

pc.expect: One glass, and oil comes only from the pour.
pc.fail: Oil appears in the glass with no stream; or the glass duplicates; or oil passes through the glass wall.

pc.expect: The glass, the bottle and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The oil changes colour; or the glass changes shape; or the background rearranges.
